chapter: La Cigalle and settling in Paris
title: Jacques Butler hires him at La Cigalle, 1955
summary: Butler led the band at La Cigalle in Paris, where Waters arrived around 1955 still planning to go home.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And this would be what, '56 or so?
Well, in '55 or 6, I won't be exact all that, see. But around '55 or 6, somethin' like that -
Most likely '55, I guess, most likely.
La Cigalle, is that what it's called?
And it was Jacques Butler's gig?
Jacques Butler had charge of the band, he hired me.
By this time had you made your decision to stay, or you're still thinkin' of comin' back to the States?
Yeah, yeah, I was still thinkin' of comin' back to the States.
You hadn't yet gone to Germany and bought this car yet -
No, I hadn't gone to Germany, bought no - I didn't have no car then.
OK, so you're in Paris, it's late '55 and you're going to La Cigalle -
